scope: one task metadata owner around the original five frozen arithmetic kernels; no residual, private operand arrays or new arithmetic
clock: 100MHz common clock; all kernels share i_rstn; asynchronous assertion with two-edge owner admission gate
input: first valid/ready locks output_mask/tags/addresses/pre/post/activate. Only input operands/lane_mask/last vary in subsequent groups. MAC bias acts only on first. Malformed first sequence or input_fault is sticky fatal.
identity: active tags must be unique; each output must match exactly one remaining active tag, type must equal !activate; activated output must be signed INT8 extended to INT16
retirement: MAC result transfers exactly once in ACC; owner remains busy through all DPP latency/backpressure until last output valid&&ready; any fault stays busy until common reset
table: only IDLE and original DPP readiness permit table transfer; table_loaded is original DPP status; table load wins over new IDLE input
numeric: signed INT8 products, frozen signed33 accumulation/INT32 last check, exact INT64 RNE/sat16 pre; activate=1 frozen SiLU/post/sat8, activate=0 pre-only raw INT16
verification: real frozen MAC/DPP/requant/round/SiLU and vendor RAM
wrong tag, duplicate output, wrong type/sign extension, malformed input and MAC overflow
